acceptanceCriteria: A sample whose base_commit is not a hex object id (for example a path with `..` components) is refused with the row number, for plain samples and ContextBench rows alike, covered by a test.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #96 (V1-0097): tools/retrieval-bench/main.go:619 resolveSnapshot joins base_commit into the corpus path without validation; a row with base_commit `../../../../tmp/evil` is accepted. Pre-existing, not introduced by #96.
title: retrieval-bench: `resolveSnapshot` joins an unchecked `base_commit` into the corpus path
